acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Ira goes out birding with birder extraordinaire Noah Strycker, who tells the dramatic story of the bird that changed his life: the turkey vulture.
acts.credits: By Ira Glass; Produced by Chloee Weiner

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Carmen Milito tells Ira the story of a date she went on as a teenager, and the bird her mom brought to the occasion.
acts.title: Don’t Chicken Out

acts.desc: Ira tromps around the woods some more with Noah Strycker, who explains, among other things, his problem with the movie Spencer.
acts.label: Act 2
acts.title: More with Noah

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Producer Bim Adewunmi on a decades-long political battle in Florida — between the incumbent state bird and the challenger that threatens to knock it off its perch.
acts.title: A Scrub Is a Bird That Can’t Get No Love From Me

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: There are the birds who exist, and then there are the birds who may as well exist. Producer Sean Cole explains.

songs.t: We’re Gonna Live in the Trees

acts.title: We Need to Talk About Birdly
